definitions.gloss: low image quality; low resolution; poor picture quality
definitions.explanation: A low level of visual quality in a photo, video, or display — blurry, pixelated, or lacking detail. Used both as a noun and, with の, as a modifier meaning low-quality or low-resolution.

examples.japanese: {低画質|ていがしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧。
⟦{通信|つうしん}{速度|そくど}→通信速度：23236_tsuushinsokudo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{低画質|ていがしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The connection was slow, so I played it at low quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ビデオ→ビデオ：01499_bideo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{低画質|ていがしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Old videos are low quality, and you can't even read the text properly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{容量|ようりょう}→容量：04887_youryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}する→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦わざと→わざと：03791_wazato⟧{低画質|ていがしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{録画|ろくが}→録画：04441_rokuga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To save storage space, sometimes I record in low quality on purpose.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{低|てい}→低〜：03961_tei⟧ (low) and ⟦{画質|がしつ}→画質：16156_gashitsu⟧ (image quality). Refers to poor resolution, blurriness, or lack of detail in images and video. It is often encountered in settings menus for video streaming, cloud storage, and camera apps.

USAGE:
- As a noun: {低画質|ていがしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (watch in low quality)
- As a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-modifier: {低画質|ていがしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧ (low-quality footage)
- Occasionally used as a な-adjective in casual writing: {低画質|ていがしつ}な⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {低画質|ていがしつ}⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧: low-quality video
- {低画質|ていがしつ}⟦モード→モード：11596_moodo⟧: low-quality mode (to save data)
- {低画質|ていがしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become low quality (e.g. after compression)
- {低画質|ていがしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to save in low quality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高画質|こうがしつ}→高画質：23668_kougashitsu⟧: high image quality — the direct antonym
- ⟦{粗|あら}い→粗い：00439_arai⟧: coarse, rough — describes visibly pixelated or grainy images
- ⟦ぼやける→ぼやける：16967_boyakeru⟧: to become blurry — refers to the image being out of focus rather than low resolution
